verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform, so publishing a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of one: the OpenAPI probe found every candidate path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the official CLI are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
